Package neqsim.process.util.optimizer

Class ConstraintActivityAnalyzer.ConstraintScale

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.util.optimizer.ConstraintActivityAnalyzer.ConstraintScale
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
Enclosing class:
ConstraintActivityAnalyzer
public static final class ConstraintActivityAnalyzer.ConstraintScale extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable reference scale tied to the exact identity of one constraint snapshot.

The reference value has the same unit as the constraint. Identity includes bounds, hardness, type, and capacity origin so a scale cannot silently be reused after the engineering constraint definition changes.

Version:
1.0
Author:
NeqSim Development Team

    • fromSnapshot

      public static ConstraintActivityAnalyzer.ConstraintScale fromSnapshot(ProcessModelSimulationEvaluator.SensitivityConstraintSnapshot snapshot, double referenceValue, String provenance)
      Creates a reference scale from an immutable constraint snapshot.
      Parameters:
      snapshot - exact constraint identity and base-state snapshot
      referenceValue - positive finite reference in the constraint unit
      provenance - non-empty source or engineering rationale for the reference
      Returns:
      immutable constraint scale
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if any argument is invalid or the constraint unit is absent
